------
CORAM: HON'BLE MR. JUSTICE ANIL KUMAR CHOUDHARY ------
For the Petitioners : Md. Razaullah Ansari, Advocate For the State : Mr. Arup Kr. Dey, Addl. P.P.
------
Order No. 03 Dated- 17.10.2023 Heard the parties.

Apprehending their arrest, the petitioners have moved this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail in connection with Lohardaga (M) P.S. Case No. 22 of 2023, registered under Sections 498A, 313, 341, 323, 504/34 of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the allegation against the petitioners is that the petitioners are the father-in-law and mother-in-law respectively who have treated the informant with cruelty in connection with demand of dowry which caused miscarriage without her consent.
It is next submitted that the allegation against the petitioners is false.
It is next submitted that the main allegation has been levelled against the husband of the informant.
It is then submitted that the petitioners are ready and willing to cooperate with the investigation of the case.
Hence, it is submitted that the petitioners be given the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned Addl. P.P. opposes the prayer for grant of anticipatory bail.

sentences.text: Considering the submissions of the counsels and the fact that the petitioners are the old persons, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioners.

Accordingly, the petitioners are directed to surrender in the Court below within a period of six weeks from today and in the event of their arrest or surrendering, they will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.25,000/-
(Twenty-five thousand) each with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned C.J.M., Lohardaga in connection with Lohardaga (M) P.S. Case No. 22 of 2023, with the condition that the petitioners will cooperate with the investigation of the case and appear before the Investigating Officer as and when noticed by him and will furnish their mobile numbers and a copy of their Aadhar Card in the court below with the undertaking that they will not change their mobile numbers during the pendency of the case and further subject to the conditions laid down under section 438(2) Cr.P.C.
(Anil Kumar Choudhary, J.) Alok/-
